My dear [Miss Erskine](/person/489),
Your letter only came to me this morning as you see I am on my travels - so though it is before Tuesday, I think I had better answer to May. I shall be at 45 Westbourne Terrace for a few days after Wednesday, and shall I hope have a good sight of [Mary Coleridge](/person/351) whom I have quite missed in Devonshire[^1]
I have told Ivanova ([Miss Batty](/person/126)) of the Institution, and if she will undertake to write an account of it, I will ask you to be kind enough to send the report either to her or to me - but I will let you know what she says -[^2]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Perhaps \'Ivanovna\', ‘Convalescent institutions’ MP (November 1866) 509-515.
